newsitem.title: CHINA: Value of Shanghai trade zone investments rises.
newsitem.headline: Value of Shanghai trade zone investments rises.

text.p: The value of new investment projects in Shanghai's Waigaoqiao free trade zone almost doubled in August from the year-earlier period despite a fall in the number of projects, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The newspaper said the zone, in the Pudong area, reported 74 new projects in August, a decline of 46 percent over August 1995, but investment in the projects almost doubled to $86 million.
The zone has been particularly successful in attracting computer-related companies to set up manufacturing facilities.
